what: fig:tp_scoop, the task-parameterized scoop of Section 2.5 drawn from the deployed model and code, in the geometry the robot used

per_frame: eta (3, tangent-chart orientation in the vial chart)

demonstrations.wall_note: not drawn in A: the demonstrations listed in beyond_r_v reach further from the bore axis than r_v but stay within |y| < r_v, so a wall drawn in the y-z projection would hide the crossing. Drawn in B, where no drawn path or Gaussian contour reaches it

surface.source: T_vialLip_surface_pose7 of the NaCl run, median over the trials without a surface failure
surface.drawn: its line in the y-z plane (exact: the rotation is about x_lip only), with p and n

view.note: as Fig. 3B/3C: z right (out of the opening), y up, x into the page

panel_A.projection: y-z plane of each frame; 1-sd contour of the y-z marginal of the position block

panel_B.placement: contact point = T_vialLip_surface @ [0, 0, s_z, 1] (tp_gmm_action.surface_frame_contact_point), the contact frame keeping the vial-lip orientation
panel_B.start: approach position [0.0, 0.0, -0.005] m in vial_lip, q_ref_eff, at rest (tp_gmm_action.py)
panel_B.deepest_below_surface_slope_note: depth of the deepest point below the estimated surface, along n, per mm of s_z into the material; linear fit over the eight offsets
panel_B.constraint_test: hard path against the same SOCP with a vial of radius 1.0 m; active if they differ by more than 0.05 mm or a clearance is not positive

record_bore_vs_normal.note: record only: the first draft moved the contact point along the bore, (0, 0, z_s + s_z); the robot moved it along n. difference = s_z (0, -sin a, cos a - 1), |difference| = 2 |s_z| sin(|a|/2), per trial with that trial's own tilt a

dropped_from_the_ga_figure: the screw-rate first-order mapping and its Monte Carlo check (TP-scoop's position block is Euclidean position)
the learned reference M_ref (+): TP-scoop has a reference orientation q_ref but no reference pose
